name: The Billionaire Bachelor
source: The Van Heusen Hotel was your whole life... until your parents were forced to sell it to your arch-nemesis, the sizzling hot, but ice-cold Reese Crane. Luckily, Reese offers you a simple solution: marry him for just 6 months, and the hotel is yours!
